decision_skill.name: validated_seasonal_blend_gate
decision_skill.description: Use a seasonal blend only when causal validation shows a material and stable improvement over a robust local-level forecast.
decision_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series with plausible seasonality and enough history for multiple non-overlapping validation windows.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Compare the seasonal blend against a robust local baseline using combined absolute-error and squared-error criteria; select the blend only when it clears a preset improvement margin and its performance remains reasonably consistent across validation subwindows.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use the rule when history is insufficient, validation is non-causal or overlapping, the improvement is marginal, or performance varies sharply across subwindows.
